input.title: [eval] deferred stays deferred
input.body:
# Deferral

## Problem

An author's decision to leave something open is theirs. A later round must not quietly convert it back into an open question.
answers: Gitflow is out of scope for v1.
A missing remote is unknown, not a skip.
PATCH is the existing gitops write; model is an extra field.
Whether org apply fans out is deferred until we have an org that size.
